name: @jbsiddall/reactive-sqlite
//libsqlite3: Every task that touches the library needs --unstable-ffi --allow-ffi and,
critically, a DENO_SQLITE_PATH pointing at the SAME libsqlite3 the driver
loads. @db/sqlite reads DENO_SQLITE_PATH once at import time and otherwise
downloads its own prebuilt library into $DENO_DIR/plug/. If our FFI dlopens
a different file, the sqlite3* handle we borrow belongs to another build
and the process dies of SIGSEGV — exit 139, no message. The tasks do not
set DENO_SQLITE_PATH for you: it is host-specific, and silently guessing it
is exactly the mistake that segfaults. Export it, or let the library's path
resolution pick a system library and pass that same value to the FFI.
--allow-net is present because the driver falls back to downloading its
library when DENO_SQLITE_PATH is unset; with it set, nothing is fetched.

tasks.check: deno fmt --check . && deno lint . && deno check

test.description: The semantic matrix: every event scenario, asserted in this process. Needs a libsqlite3 (see //libsqlite3).

test:crash.description: The crash matrix: every case runs in its OWN child process and is asserted on its exit code, so a genuine segfault (139) can never be mistaken for a pass. --allow-run is unscoped because the child is Deno.execPath(), known only at runtime; the only program spawned is this same Deno binary running test/crash_cases.ts.

demo.description: Run the demo in examples/: every commit-lifecycle event, the precommit veto, batching and the preupdate row values, against a real database. Not a test; needs --allow-ffi and a libsqlite3 (see //libsqlite3).

vendor:build.description: Build the vendored libsqlite3 from the pinned SQLite amalgamation into vendor/lib/<target>/. Needs a C compiler, curl and openssl; no Deno permissions are involved because the work is done by build.sh. Pass --arch aarch64 to cross-compile.

vendor:smoke.description: Compile smoke_test.c against a built library and run it, so a binary is only trusted after it has executed. Pass --arch aarch64 to run the cross-built library under qemu-user.

vendor:probe.description: Report which SQLite capabilities a libsqlite3 actually has, side by side. With no arguments it compares the prebuilt @db/sqlite downloads, the system library and the vendored build. Needs --allow-ffi.

vendor:session-demo.description: Prove the SESSION extension works in the vendored build: record a session, produce a changeset, apply it to a second database, then invert it to undo. Raw FFI, no driver. Needs --allow-ffi.
